cited_evidence: The application requests all permissions available (11 out of 11
permissions requested), which is a common tactic used by malware
to gain extensive control over the device.
A large number of system calls (7112 distinct syscalls) suggests
the app may be performing complex operations that could indicate
malicious behavior, such as hiding or modifying other apps' data
reasoning: The combination of requesting all available permissions and a high volume of system calls is highly suspicious. Typically, legitimate applications do not require so many permissions nor perform such an extensive number of system calls. This behavior aligns more with that of malware attempting to gain control over the device or intercept sensitive data.
